Portrait companion adapted from ShawndYang/AnimalDuo for ACNH Mobile.
Reviewed upstream: 3ddaea8c9b115e259d252e6d1b66e2f360ba563c.
Six-page companion with checked inventory interactions and native phone actions.
Retains the existing .data reader, controls, portrait geometry and title-ready A synchronization.
Does not integrate upstream resident management, backup/cloud saves or experimental LAN visits.
Original licenses and attribution retained. Combined distribution is GPL-3.0-or-later.
